newsitem.title: USA: Maine's Mitchell seen winning House Speaker race.
newsitem.headline: Maine's Mitchell seen winning House Speaker race.

text.p: Maine's House of representatives is expected to be led by Representative Elizabeth Mitchell, D-Vassalboro, because Representative Steve Rowe, D-Portland, has withdrawn from the race.

House Democrats will meet over the weekend to formally nominate a candidate for speaker and elect floor leaders. With 81 of the 151 House seats in Democratic hands, Mitchell's election as speaker is assured if party members hold firm.
Mitchell says Democrats will work for property tax relief and programs to help kids.
Separately, there have been no changes in the first four of a dozen election recounts for the House of Representatives.
In recounts completed, the closest race in the state was settled.
Democrat Paul Tessier of Fairfield apparently defeated Republican William Hagerty by a single vote on election night, but the recount increased his margin to five votes.
And Republican Robert Fisk saw his margin cut in half. But he is still the winner over Democrat Gerald Davis. Two more recounts are scheduled for today.
